R2.rule: Intersect C001-centered intervals with full bounds; selected surface categories allowed; unselected full 5-variable blocks exactly C001. Inherited PSO bounds/clipping is retained. No additional repair clipping or resampling.

K6.name: K6_WARM_FULL
K6.initialization: particle0 exact C001; remaining global feasible random layouts

bootstrap.unit: 8 paired optimizer search seeds after averaging 5 shared physical seeds

representative_rule.K2: P0-selected primary endpoint for that seed

overall_gate.inconclusive: Any invalid geometry/baseline, incomplete primary endpoint/terminal data, budget interruption, numerical failure or severe scene fidelity mismatch
overall_gate.confirmed: support>=3 and no scene mean gain<=-0.50 pp
overall_gate.conditional: support==2 or (support>=3 and any scene mean gain<=-0.50 pp)
overall_gate.not_confirmed: complete valid data, no severe fidelity flag and support<=1
overall_gate.directional_dependence: secondary description only; never overrides support-count Gate

fidelity.unit: 24 distinct endpoint identities per scene (3 pairs x 8 optimizer seeds), even when layouts coincide
fidelity.P0_vs_P4: archived P0 direct search best versus same-layout five-seed P4 mean
fidelity.rank_ties: Exact ties broken solely by frozen endpoint ID; ordinal ranks for Spearman
fidelity.paired_SE: sample SD of five same-physical-seed differences divided by sqrt(5)
fidelity.severe: All three criteria simultaneously; any scene severe makes overall INCONCLUSIVE
fidelity.undefined: If scores constant or metrics undefined: DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_EVALUABLE, no automatic severe label

rollback.denominator: particle proposals passed through original repair, excluding initialization draws
rollback.per_configuration: pooled proposals by scene/pair/phase across declared seeds

selection.StageA: descending median of two per-run P0 bests, then descending maximum best, then ascending pair ID; exact ties
selection.primary_K2: highest endpoint P0 search best among same-scene same-seed selected three pairs; exact ties lower pair ID; freeze all before any P4
selection.K6: per-run best incumbent including initial C001
selection.terminal: All 132 scene endpoints x5 physical seeds, plus five shared EMPTY C001 calls; no deduplication that omits declared endpoint evaluations
